mintAuthority.summary: MetaMask USD is an M0-backed extension; extension wrapping routes through M0 extension infrastructure while base M issuance remains on the Ethereum MinterGateway.

controls.label: M0 MinterGateway backing rail
controls.capDescription: Base M issuance backing MUSD depends on approved minters, validator attestations, mint-delay review, and M0 collateral/debt checks.

routeChecks.attestorQuorum: M0 docs describe validator attestations before minting; this review did not enumerate the live validator threshold.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: MinterGateway minting is bounded by approved-Minter status, collateral/debt checks, and mint-delay review before MToken mint.
routeChecks.caps: Per-Minter capacity can be changed by M0 TTG governance, so the cap is protocol-governed rather than immutable.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: MinterGateway is confirmed immutable/non-proxy; cap governance remains with M0 TTG and Registrar governance.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294742: Blockscout confirms ContractName=MinterGateway, IsProxy=false (immutable, non-upgradeable). EIP-1967 admin and impl slots both zero. No external admin or module surface; cap governance rests with M0 TTG (POWER token holders).

controls.label: M0 SwapFacility extension router
controls.capDescription: SwapFacility routes approved M0 extensions 1:1 against M; it can mint extension balances through wrap flows but does not create base M supply.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: SwapFacility wraps approved M0 extensions 1:1 against M and does not create base M supply.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: Extension minting is bounded by available M-backed wrapper flow and base M supply.
routeChecks.caps: SwapFacility cap follows M supply and can be changed through the M0 governance/admin path rather than an immutable cap.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Ethereum SwapFacility is a TransparentUpgradeableProxy controlled by ProxyAdmin -> TimelockController with a 3-day delay and Gnosis Safe proposer.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294742: Blockscout confirms ContractName=TransparentUpgradeableProxy, IsProxy=true, impl=0x45bf08d042a8958f01f8e8319b791e4584550da8 (impl code 15869 bytes). ProxyAdmin (EIP-1967 admin slot) = 0x0f38d8a5583f9316084e9c40737244870c565924 (ContractName=ProxyAdmin on Blockscout). ProxyAdmin owner = TimelockController 0x23ca665c8a73292fc7ac2cc4493d2ce883bba468 (3-day minDelay=259200s). Timelock proposer = Gnosis Safe 0xb7a9b5f301ef3bad36c2b4964e82931dd7fb989c (5 owners, threshold 3); executor = 0xf2f1acbe0ba726fee8d75f3e32900526874740bb. SwapFacility cap follows M supply; canRaiseCap=true via M0 TTG governance.

controls.label: M0 SwapFacility extension router
controls.capDescription: SwapFacility routes approved M0 extensions 1:1 against M; it can mint extension balances through wrap flows but does not create base M supply.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: SwapFacility wraps approved M0 extensions 1:1 against M and does not create base M supply.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: Extension minting is bounded by available M-backed wrapper flow and base M supply.
routeChecks.caps: SwapFacility cap follows M supply and can be changed through the M0 governance/admin path rather than an immutable cap.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Linea SwapFacility is treated as the same proxy-admin pattern by deployment convention; the Linea-specific proxy admin slot was not independently read.

controls.evidence: SwapFacility at same address 0xB6807116b3B1B321a390594e31ECD6e0076f6278 on Linea; same deployment pattern as Ethereum (TransparentUpgradeableProxy, same ProxyAdmin → TimelockController admin structure per M0 deployment convention). Linea-specific proxy admin slot not independently read.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294742: MinterGateway confirmed immutable non-proxy (Blockscout ContractName=MinterGateway, IsProxy=false). SwapFacility (Ethereum) confirmed TransparentUpgradeableProxy; ProxyAdmin=0x0f38d8a5... → TimelockController 0x23ca665c... (minDelay=259200s, 3 days); timelock proposer is Gnosis Safe 3/5 (0xb7a9b5f3...). Linea SwapFacility: EIP-1967 admin slot confirmed same ProxyAdmin 0x0f38d8a5... (identical governance). All controls fully characterized.
